correctness.rationale: The two stages give z_i^+=(1-cv_i)z_i+hω_iJz_i, and orthogonality reduces conservation to M_1-2cM_1+c²M_2=0. Both moments are strictly positive; the source's plus-root for ε gives the smaller c root, valid up to the double root M_2=M_1. At each successful step the active set is unchanged because F_i>=v_i>0. Writing r=M_2/M_1, the top factor exceeds each lower factor by c²(v_*-v_i)(v_*+v_i-r)>=(v_*-v_i)v_i/4. For v_*<=1, F_*<=2 on the near branch, so every lower-to-top ratio contracts uniformly, and total energy conservation implies the stated geometric concentration; the top group grows strictly whenever a lower group is active. For v_*>1, r<=1 forces F_*>=1+v_*(v_*-1)/4 at each successful step, giving the floor bound and ruling out indefinite feasibility. The exact example has initial M_1-M_2=3/256 and strictly negative next gap; independent symbolic reconstruction checks the discriminant scaling and witness.
residual_risks: Exact arithmetic, fixed step and finitely many orthogonal linear oscillator modes only. No assertion for general nonlinear equations, roundoff, or adaptive steps.
